caption: Remap: the Speed slider's 0..1 turned into between 2 and 8 stripes
why: Sliders on the WLED page give 0..1; what an effect needs is a number of stripes from 2 to 8, a speed from 0.1 to 3, a size from a few pixels to half the matrix. Remap turns one range into another: what was in low..in high becomes out low..out high.

It is the everyday node between controls and the things they control. Its neighbours: Map range is the same with everything on pins, steps and easing; Clamp only cuts; Multiply and Add do part of it; Remap is the whole job in one.
steps: **x** is the **Speed** slider's `value`, 0..1 (the slider starts at the middle, so 0.5).
**in low** 0 and **in high** 1 is the slider's range; **out low** 2 and **out high** 8 is the range of stripes: the slider at the left gives 2, at the right 8, in the middle 5.
The result is the **count** of a **Stripes** node, scrolling with a clock; the **Palette** colours them.
Move the Speed slider in the side panel's PARAMETERS and the number of stripes follows.

try.label: Up to sixteen
try.text: out high 16: the same slider now spans 2 to 16 stripes - at the middle, 9.

try.label: Reverse
try.text: out low 8 and out high 2: the slider runs the other way - more stripes at the left.
